test_title: PYST 22: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which statement is INCORRECT about a household electric circuit?

options.text: All appliances are connected in parallel.
A fuse is always connected in the live wire.
Current through each appliance is the same.
A fuse protects the circuit from excessive current.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Current through each appliance is the same.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **All appliances are connected in parallel:** In household electric circuits, appliances are connected in parallel. This ensures that each appliance receives the same voltage as the main supply, and they can operate independently without affecting one another. ***This statement is correct.***
 
• **A fuse is always connected in the live wire:** The fuse is a safety device that is connected to the live wire to protect the circuit from excessive current. It breaks the circuit when the current exceeds the safe limit. ***This statement is correct.***
 
• **Current through each appliance is the same:** This statement is ***incorrect***. In a parallel connection, the current through each appliance depends on its resistance or power rating. The total current in the circuit is the sum of the currents through all individual appliances.
